description: CDN deployment zones for the Accessibility Widget. Assets live in the SHARED R2 bucket bg-widgets (fronted by widgets.professional-hosting.com), scoped to the accessibility-widget/ prefix with its OWN per-prefix manifests, so sync-delete only ever removes keys this repo wrote — it NEVER touches other projects' assets (e.g. console-banner/) in the same bucket.

zones.name: accessibility-widget-cf
zones.description: Cloudflare R2 + CDN. Dual-path: each release uploads the build to an immutable accessibility-widget/<x.y.z>/ root (cached forever, SRI-safe to pin) and a floating accessibility-widget/v<major>/ root (short edge TTL, purged each deploy). Only the floating URLs are purged.
